title: PIC: Enable Large-Scale Privacy Preserving Content-Based Image Search on Cloud
venue: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems
motivation: 用户隐私顾虑阻碍云端图像服务普及，现有加密方案无法支持内容检索
problem_framing: 在大规模加密图像上进行非交互式相似度搜索，同时保护图像和查询隐私
key_insight: 多层次同态加密配合密钥转换实现云端密文运算，关键代理解密距离而非特征向量
method_signature: 双层搜索(聚类匹配+近邻搜索)结合MapReduce并行化
evaluation_criteria: 搜索准确率、计算开销、通信开销、隐私安全性
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 高分辨率图像密文过大，移动设备无法接受；MapReduce直接实现因排序导致reducer只能为1
evidence_for_taste: homomorphic encryption to achieve private vector distance measurement, but reveal search results to the cloud
gigabytes of encrypted data would be unacceptable for many mobile devices
sorting limits the number of reducers to one
accuracy loss caused by quantizing the feature vector space
the extra overhead is due to image encryption, key modifications
thinking_moves: 将隐私保护问题分解为多层密钥管理，通过密钥转换而非重加密实现权限移交
从准确最近邻搜索退化为近似搜索以换取并行化可行性
通过视觉词袋量化降低特征向量维度，从而压缩密文大小
cites_own_work: [12] PoP: Privacy-preserving outsourced photo sharing and searching for mobile devices
[3] Privacy-friendly photo capturing and sharing system
[39] Message in a sealed bottle: Privacy preserving friending in mobile social networks
